description_en: This API operation lets a third-party platform send a call request to a hosted call center. The system calls the customer, then an agent, and connects them
description_zh: 通过本接口，第三方平台可以给托管型呼叫中心发送呼叫请求，系统分别呼叫客户和座席，先呼叫客户再呼叫座席,并把双方接通
name: CloudWebcall

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number. For landlines, include the area code. For mobile numbers, do not add the `0` prefix. For landlines with an extension, use a hyphen (-) as a separator. You can specify multiple numbers separated by commas (,). The system calls each number in sequence. If a call is answered, the system stops calling the remaining numbers. For an [encrypted outbound call](../%E5%AD%97%E6%AE%B5%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89/%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3%E9%83%A8%E5%88%86/%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E5%A4%96%E5%91%BC%E5%8F%B7%E7%A0%81%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99.md), you must URL-encode the phone numbers
parameters.help_zh: 电话号码；固话带区号，手机不加0；固话带分机的以'-'分隔；支持多个号码，多个直接用英文逗号’,’分隔；传多个号码时，若前面的号码没接通则会呼叫后面的号码，若接通则不会呼叫；[加密外呼](../字段定义/接口部分/加密外呼号码加密规则.md)；如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入
parameters.name: tel

parameters.help_en: A unique request ID, up to 300 bytes long. The system saves this ID to the `requestUniqueId` field in the call record, which you can use for later queries. All calls from a single API request share the same `requestUniqueId`
parameters.help_zh: 请求唯一标识；说明：长度不超过300个字节。1个汉字是3字节。此字段保存到通话记录requestUniqueId字段，后续接口查询使用。一次接口请求造成的多次呼叫requestUniqueId相同；如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en: A user-defined field, up to 250 bytes long. This value is saved to the `userField` in the call record for later queries. This parameter only takes effect if `paramNames` is set
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义字段；说明：长度不超过250个字节。1个汉字是3字节。此字段保存到通话记录userField字段，后续接口查询使用。该字段需“动态附带参数”paramNames有值时方可生效
parameters.name: user_field

parameters.help_en: The timeout for the customer call, in seconds. The value must be between 0 and 60, inclusive. The default is 30
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫客户超时时间；说明：参数取值范围 0<=timeout<=60；不传入，默认30(单位:s)
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable answering machine detection (AMD). Valid values: `1` (enable) and `0` (disable). The default is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启amd；自动应答检查（传真机等），1.开启 0.不开启 默认为0
parameters.name: amd

parameters.help_en: The call initiation delay, in seconds. The value must be between 0 and 60, inclusive. The default is 0
parameters.help_zh: 延迟时长；秒数，延迟多少秒呼叫 参数取值范围：0<=delay<=60 默认为0
parameters.name: delay

parameters.help_en: The delay, in seconds, between call attempts when `Tel` contains multiple numbers. The maximum value is 120. The default is 0
parameters.help_zh: 多号码时呼叫延时；tel多个号码时，号码之间的呼叫延迟，最大120秒，默认0
parameters.name: multi_tel_delay

parameters.help_en: When calling multiple numbers, this parameter specifies whether to send a hang-up notification for each call attempt. Valid values: `0` (sends one notification for the entire process) and `1` (sends a notification for each attempt). The default is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 多号码，是否每个号码呼叫都挂机推送；取值说明 0：只挂机推送一次； 1：每次呼叫都触发挂机推送；默认0
parameters.name: multi_tel_push

parameters.help_en: The caller ID to display to the recipient. You can use an enterprise trunk number or a pre-configured caller ID
parameters.help_zh: 可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: To use this parameter, your account must support identifier-based routing. This parameter has a lower priority than `Clid`
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码组；使用clidGroup需要账号支持按标识路由，优先级低于clid
parameters.name: clid_group

parameters.help_en: Specifies a set of caller IDs for the outbound call. The system selects an available number from this set based on the number scheduling policy
parameters.help_zh: 指定本次外呼使用的客户侧外显号码集合，系统将根据号码调度策略选择可用号码进行外呼
parameters.name: clid_list

parameters.help_en: A caller ID from a specific region. This parameter has a lower priority than `Clid`
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显指定地区号码，优先级低于clid
parameters.name: clid_area_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IVR flow to enter after the call connects. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the IVR flow configured in the console
parameters.help_zh: 回呼接通后进入的ivrId；如果不传此参数，使用后台配置的ivr
parameters.name: ivr_id

parameters.help_en: The language of the IVR prompt. Valid values: `1` (Mandarin), `2` (Cantonese), `4` (Biaobei TTS), and `5` (Mandarin - sweet female voice). The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 用哪种语言播放ivr提示音；1.普通话 2.粤语 4.标贝TTS 5.普通话-甜美女音 默认为1
parameters.name: vid

parameters.help_en: The number of retries. The maximum value is 5. To use this parameter, you must enable the webcall auto-retry feature for your enterprise account
parameters.help_zh: 重试次数；最大5次，使用的企业需要开启webcall自动重试开关
parameters.name: retry

parameters.help_en: The retry interval, in minutes. The value must be between 0 and 59, inclusive
parameters.help_zh: 重试间隔，单位分钟，最小0分钟，最大59分钟
parameters.name: retry_interval

parameters.help_en: The request's expiration time, accurate to the second. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`
parameters.name: expir_time

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
